# Ved Prashnavali

> Free devotional tools in English and Hindi: the Ram Shalaka, Hanuman and Sai Baba prashnavalis (traditional question-and-answer charts), a daily reading, and a naam jaap counter. Run from Delhi, India. No login, no fees.

A prashnavali is a Hindu practice for seeking guidance on a question: the seeker prays, holds the question in mind, and chooses a letter or number from a sacred chart; the chart leads to a verse or saying read as the answer.

## Tools

- [Ram Shalaka Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/prash): a 225-letter chart from Shri Ramcharitmanas leading to one of nine chaupais, each with its source, meaning and whether it is favourable. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/prash
- [Hanuman Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/hanumanprash): a chakra of 49 numbers, each with a verse and a yes-or-no answer. Hindi version: https://vedprashnavali.com/hi/hanumanprash
- [Sai Baba Prashnavali](https://vedprashnavali.com/saibabaprash): 720 numbered answers for devotees of Shirdi Sai Baba.
- [Today's Guidance](https://vedprashnavali.com/today): one reading a day from Shri Ram or Hanuman Ji.
- [Naam Jaap Counter](https://vedprashnavali.com/jaap): a digital mala of 108 for counting jaap, with an explanation of the practice.
